items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I went back home and I played with Benny Carter. ... I was out on the west coast when I joined Benny Carter‘s band.

ctx.x: Okay. So in California you went, you worked with Lionel Hampton and Les Hite and Benny Carter as well. Did you work with Benny Carter‘s band?

Yes, I did. I cannot put that together. I went back home and I played with Benny Carter. I can‘t…Benny Carter…I was out on the west coast when I joined Benny Carter‘s band. I went on the west coast and was playing with Les Hite‘s band. And Les Hite‘s band wasn‘t playing that much. And I think Gerald Wilson and myself and two other trumpet players joined Benny Carter‘s band. A Complete trumpet section went in Benny Carter‘s band. And we stayed in the band for quite a while, but that‘s what happened there.
Uh huh, okay. So you made a couple of films, one in nineteen, you made some films, a short film; 1941 with Jimmie Lunceford called Blues in the Night.
